title: vertx-graphql fails in native mode - GraphQLInputDeserializer has no default (no arg) constructor
body:
integration-tests/vertx-graphql fails in native mode - GraphQLInputDeserializer has no default (no arg) constructor

```
Caused by: java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: Class

  has no default (no arg) constructor
	at com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.util.ClassUtil.createInstance(ClassUtil.java:554)
	
```
